profile: Sustainability and existing-buildings consultancy. Retrofits campuses and decarbonises plant, but never the same building twice, so its two halves sit in different job families.

projects.title: Riverside College Deep Retrofit
projects.narrative: Deep energy retrofit of five academic buildings, with envelope upgrades, controls and a measurement and verification regime.

projects.title: Auralia State Library Retrofit
projects.narrative: Library retrofit with a new envelope, daylight controls and a reduced-airflow stack environment.

projects.title: Whitmore Residence Hall Recommissioning
projects.narrative: Recommissioning and mechanical renewal across eleven residence halls, delivered between academic terms.

projects.title: State Office Portfolio Decarbonisation
projects.narrative: Portfolio decarbonisation across nine state office buildings, with heat pumps, controls and a central plant conversion.

projects.title: Calder Civic Centre Electrification
projects.narrative: Electrification of a civic centre, replacing gas plant with air-source heat pumps.

projects.title: Northgate Schools Envelope Programme
projects.narrative: Roof and envelope programme across twelve school buildings.

projects.title: Cascade Health Energy Programme
projects.narrative: Energy programme across a hospital estate, with plant renewal and continuous commissioning.

projects.title: Whitmore Athletics Retrofit
projects.narrative: Mechanical and lighting retrofit of an athletics building.

projects.title: Port Estate Audit Programme
projects.narrative: Energy audit and retro-commissioning across port-owned buildings.

projects.title: Confidential Portfolio Assessment
projects.narrative: Portfolio energy assessment under a non-disclosure agreement; the institution and the buildings cannot be named to a third party.
